node.title: Re: Is it possible load optional modules from PERL5OPT?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: If you're comfortable building your own Perl, perhaps you're looking for [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/blob/a7a1d5e9015d8a91fdcbb00d176697ff84a3bc78/INSTALL?plain=1#L916|sitecustomize.pl]. However, this sounds like it may also be an X/Y Problem - what does your internal module do?
